issue_request: FHIR-14706 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CodeSystem clarification asking whether the words 'subsume', 'subsumes', 'subsumed', and 'subsumption' are defined by CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning or differently by each code system. The resolution clarified that the words are defined in relation to the hierarchy type identified for the represented code system by CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning.
